name: Proschanie na Dere
source:
The Fog, which sows anger and hatred, covers the City, but no one but the protagonist notices it.

To stop the Fog, he sacrifices everything.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445290/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
散播愤怒与仇恨的迷雾笼罩着这座城市，然而，除了主角之外，没有人察觉到它。

为了阻止迷雾，他牺牲了一切。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445290/]Steam[/url]]
